metadata.case_name: CHAN SUET KEUNG v. YIU SHUI FOR T/A WING YIP METAL FACTORY

plaintiff.occupation_before: employed by the defendant to work afoot operated power press for making holes in the metal wheels for toy cars

injuries.description: the plaintiff's hand went inside and his right index finger was severely crushed. He was taken to Princess Margaret Hospital where the first 2½ phalanges o?that finger were amputated.
source: the plaintiff's hand went inside and his right index finger was severely crushed. He was taken to Princess Margaret Hospital where the first 2½ phalanges o?that finger were amputated.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

manifestations.description: the loss of the major part of his right index finger does make picking up or gripping heavy objects more difficult and it is undoubtedly a handicap
12% permanent disability (as assessed by Dr Wu Kwok Chai)

treatments_received: amputation of the first 2½ phalanges of the right index finger

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of the amenities of life (general damages awarded)
Loss of earning capacity (assessed as 12% of earnings multiplied by multiplier)
